name: glasser
description: Research companies, markets and the web inside ChatGPT. Glasser connects ChatGPT to live data on companies and prospects, search rankings and keywords, websites and online reviews, social profiles, local businesses, news and property records. Ask things like "What industry is example.com in and how many employees does it have?" or "Compare search visibility for example.com and a competitor", and ChatGPT finds a suitable data endpoint, shows what it needs, and runs it once you approve. Built for sales, marketing and research teams that need answers grounded in returned data.

interface.longDescription: Research companies, markets and the web inside ChatGPT. Glasser connects ChatGPT to live data on companies and prospects, search rankings and keywords, websites and online reviews, social profiles, local businesses, news and property records. Ask things like "What industry is example.com in and how many employees does it have?" or "Compare search visibility for example.com and a competitor", and ChatGPT finds a suitable data endpoint, shows what it needs, and runs it once you approve. Built for sales, marketing and research teams that need answers grounded in returned data.
defaultPrompt: Find the industry, employee count and headquarters of example.com.
Compare organic search traffic and top keywords for example.com and a competitor in the US.
Summarize what users say about an app in its recent App Store reviews.

positive.description: Sales call brief: company profile, size, recent news and website traffic trend.
positive.prompt: I have a sales call with Notion next week. Give me a short brief: what the company does, how big it is, what has been in the news about it in the past month, and how its website traffic has trended recently.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms each run in ChatGPT, returns a short brief covering Notion's business, size, news from the past month and recent website traffic trend, labels estimates as estimates and says what data is missing.

positive.description: Competitor search visibility and keyword gaps.
positive.prompt: Compare how visible notion.so, coda.io and clickup.com are in US Google search, and list five keywords where coda.io ranks in the top 10 but notion.so does not.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms each run in ChatGPT, compares the three domains' estimated US organic search visibility and lists five keywords where coda.io ranks in the top 10 and notion.so does not.

positive.description: App feedback from recent App Store reviews; the run is asynchronous.
positive.prompt: What are the three most common complaints and the three most praised features in recent App Store reviews of the Duolingo app?
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms the run in ChatGPT, gets the result with runs_get while it is still working, then lists three common complaints and three praised features from the returned reviews with short examples.

positive.description: Location research for a new coffee shop: nearby competitors, ratings and review themes.
positive.prompt: I'm thinking of opening a coffee shop near Union Square in San Francisco. Which coffee shops are already within walking distance, how are they rated, and what do reviewers praise or complain about most?
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms each run in ChatGPT, lists nearby coffee shops with their ratings and summarizes what reviewers praise and complain about most.

positive.description: Creator research: YouTube channels in a niche with audience size and recent topics.
positive.prompt: Find three active YouTube channels that review project management software, with their subscriber counts and what their most recent videos were about.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user confirms each run in ChatGPT, lists three relevant YouTube channels with subscriber counts and the topics of their most recent videos.

negative.description: The user supplies the text, so ChatGPT rewrites it directly without Glasser.
negative.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph to sound clearer and shorter: Our team has been working very hard over the past several months in order to make sure that the new version of the product is able to meet all of the needs that our customers have told us about, and we are very excited to finally be able to share it with everyone.

negative.description: A writing task that needs no external data; ChatGPT drafts the email directly without calling Glasser, even though a company is named.
negative.prompt: Draft a short cold email to Stripe's head of sales introducing our analytics product.

negative.description: General knowledge; ChatGPT answers directly without calling Glasser, even though the topic is SEO.
negative.prompt: Explain the difference between SEO and SEM.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. Users sign in to an existing Glasser account with OAuth; no checkout, subscription or upgrade flow appears in the plugin.

publication.release_notes: First submission of Glasser: one skill and the Glasser MCP server (search endpoints, inspect their inputs and Price, run with the user's authorization, get run results).
